title: AI File Sources: Keep Knowledge in Step With a Folder | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Much of a company's knowledge lives in folders that another system keeps up to date, such as handbooks, price sheets and nightly exports. A CrestApps AI file source reads a folder on a schedule, on the site's server or on an FTP or SFTP server, and keeps an assistant's knowledge current without anyone uploading a file.

In this video:
• Why uploads go stale, and how a file source follows the folder
• How the knowledge base index, the Files data source and the file source fit together
• Creating the index, a Files data source and a file source
• Reading the folder now and understanding the last run
• The FTP and SFTP connectors
• Giving an assistant the data source, and an answer with its sources
